node: K-12 virtual schooling and career-learning operating stack
summary: Layer 1B expands the K-12 virtual schooling and career-learning operating-stack node beyond the obvious virtual-school operator. The most relevant public-market map has two lanes: reference operators that prove demand and operating complexity, and underfollowed suppliers embedded in curriculum, school transformation, payment administration, and regulated education workflow infrastructure. The chokepoint hypothesis remains an inference: scalable accredited virtual schooling requires curriculum, certified teachers, state compliance, payments, reporting, student support, and career-readiness services, not just content.
